jobs.name: portal_only_master

reference_images.usage: Keep its white/cyan/violet swirling portal energy and aperture identity, remove the entire metal gate, brackets and mechanical frame.
Upright floating oval orientation and pure energy edge.

args.description: FRAME FORMAT256x256 RGBA, fixed pivot128,128. Pixel-art free-standing upright oval warp PORTAL ONLY, for a top-down Neo-Geo space shooter ship to fly through. Preserve the reference portal's white/cyan/violet energy spiral and dark luminous depth; the aperture stands vertically toward the viewer, oval axis upright, full 210px tall energy ring contained with at least16px transparent margins. Remove ALL gate hardware, stone, metal, brackets, support feet, bolts, pedestal and frame. Only a turbulent layered violet/cyan/white energy ring, rotating inner wisps receding into a dark blue dimensional center, clear passable central aperture. Deliberate crisp pixel clusters, consistent specular energy layers, high contrast but restrained bloom, no circle lying flat on ground, no background, no text, no ship, no scene. One centered portal sprite.
